signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own some key areas of Sekai’s consumer product experience, including creation, discovery, feed experience, sharing, retention, and creator/player engagement
Turn ambiguous user problems into clear product hypotheses, priorities, requirements, and execution plans
Analyze user behavior, funnels, retention, engagement, feedback, and product metrics to identify opportunities
Define success metrics for product launches and experiments
Work closely with engineering, design, data, growth, and operations to ship quickly
